title: Artificial Intelligence for Good Governance in Universities: Science Mapping of Present and Future Trends
core_idea: Conduct a bibliometric analysis of Web of Science literature (2010–2025) using bibliographic coupling and co-word analysis to explore and map the knowledge structure and research trends on the application of AI for good governance in universities.
tldr: Map the research landscape on using AI to support transparency, accountability, financial and institutional governance in universities through bibliometric techniques to identify current and future research trends.
